summary: Implemented JSON pretty printing in the repository, without running tests or repo code and without committing. Changes: rich/highlighter.py adds JSONHighlighter (base style "json.", one combined pattern for brace, true/false/null, number, str). rich/default_styles.py adds the six json.* theme entries. rich/json.py (new) adds the JSON renderable (parses with loads, serializes with dumps(indent), applies the chosen highlighter, sets no_wrap=True and overflow=None, returns the Text via __rich__) plus a __main__ entry that prints a file with soft_wrap=True and exits -1 on read failure. rich/console.py adds Console.print_json after print, importing JSON lazily. rich/__init__.py adds package-level print_json after print, delegating to the global console. Docs: a "Printing JSON" section in docs/source/console.rst, new docs/source/reference/json.rst, and the toctree entry in reference.rst. CHANGELOG.md gains one Unreleased Added line. tests/test_json.py (new) has a styled Console test, an indent test, a package-level capture test, and a renderable test. Not verified: the styled test's expected SGR codes were derived by reading rich's Style rendering, not by running it. Choices: json.py imports dumps/loads directly to avoid shadowing by the json parameter; "overflow to none" is implemented as None.
